review_candidates.title: Technical Supporter
review_candidates.description: Job Description Who will you be working with? You will be part of the regional Technical Support and Field Services organization, working closely with Metro/Public Railway customers, local Sales teams, Wabtec Field Services, and SISCO Engineering teams. In this role, you will act as a key technical interface between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure high-quality service and customer satisfaction. How will you make a difference? As a Technical Supporter, you will support Metro/Public Railway customers by responding to technical support requests in a quality‑, cost‑, and target‑oriented manner. You will ensure strong customer relationships, provide technical expertise, support sales activities through technical insights, and contribute to maintaining Wabtec’s reputation for reliable and innovative railway solutions. What will your typical day look like? Act as the primary technical contact for local Metro/Public Railway customers, including field service, maintenance, and technical operations teams. Maintain close customer relationships through regular communication and on‑site visits. Ensure customer satisfaction by meeting defined quality standards and following company procedures and protocols. Identify customer needs and provide technical recommendations to support the Sales team in generating potential sales leads. Develop and maintain in‑depth knowledge of Wabtec products and services used in the domestic market. Collaborate with Wabtec Field Services and SISCO Engineering teams to resolve technical issues, claims, and customer requests. Prepare and deliver technical presentations to customers, focusing on solutions, innovations, and value creation. Support the Sales team in preparing customer offers in line with Wabtec technical guidelines and tools. Plan and execute regular customer visits to monitor product usage, system performance, and customer satisfaction. Maintain accurate and up‑to‑date technical documentation related to customer platforms and Wabtec/competitor products. Support annual customer demand and order forecasting through technical input. Assist in planning and conducting local technical or specialist events. Resolve technical disputes and warranty claims. Conduct or lead product repairs and overhaul services and prepare detailed service reports aligned with schedules. What do we want to know about you? Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electro‑Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 5 years of experience in product engineering, systems maintenance, technical support, technical project management, or engineering of technically sophisticated products. Strong technical knowledge of railway platforms and systems, with a willingness to continuously learn and develop. Customer‑oriented mindset with strong ownership, problem‑solving skills, and the ability to manage deadlines independently. Team player with effective communication skills. Fluent Turkish and English. Proficiency in MS Office applications and ERP systems. No military service obligation. Willingness to travel regularly between cities Additional Information What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First? At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you. Who are we? Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike. Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com. Culture powers us and the possibilities. We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more. Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

review_candidates.title: Technical Office Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Royal Scape is a facilities services company headquartered in Torrance, California, serving a range of commercial and residential properties. The organization focuses on delivering reliable, quality-driven services that support safe, efficient, and well-maintained environments. Royal Scape values technical competency, operational excellence, and collaboration across its teams. The company provides opportunities for professional growth in engineering and facilities management. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas that improve service delivery and client satisfaction. Role Description The Technical Office Engineer will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, and updating technical documentation, including shop drawings, bills of quantities (BOQ), and project reports. This full-time, on-site role is based in Cairo, Egypt, and involves coordinating with project managers, site engineers, and subcontractors to ensure that designs and quantities are accurate and aligned with project specifications. Day-to-day tasks include performing quantity take-offs, supporting tender and cost estimation processes, and verifying that civil and electrical engineering requirements are integrated into project plans. The Technical Office Engineer will track project progress, assist in resolving technical issues, and maintain organized records and documentation for all assigned projects. The role also requires adherence to safety, quality, and compliance standards while supporting efficient project execution. Qualifications Strong proficiency in shop drawings and BOQ preparation, with the ability to interpret and develop detailed technical documentation. Solid foundation in Civil Engineering, including structural concepts, materials, and construction methods relevant to facilities projects. Applied knowledge of Electrical Engineering principles as they relate to building systems and integrated facility services. Experience in Quantity Surveying, including quantity take-offs, cost estimation, and verification of contractor invoices. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Proficiency in relevant engineering and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, MS Office; familiarity with BIM tools is an advantage). Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills, with attention to detail and accuracy. Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate with multi-disciplinary site and office teams. Previous experience in facilities services, construction, or engineering projects in Egypt or the region is preferred.
